content.content:
The user asks: "Who are the members of the current British Royal Family and who are their respective fathers?" We need to provide a list of members (likely the senior members) and father for each. Need to be careful: The British Royal Family includes many extended members. Probably they want the main line: King Charles III, Queen Camilla (but father is not relevant as she is queen consort, father deceased). The question: "members of the current British Royal family and who are their respective fathers". Could include children etc. Provide a table: Name, Relationship, Father.

We need to include current members: King Charles III (father: Prince Philip), Queen Camilla (father: Bruce Shand), Prince William, Prince of Wales (father: King Charles III), Catherine, Princess of Wales (father: Michael Middleton), Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex (father: King Charles III), Meghan (father: Thomas Markle), Princess Beatrice (father: Prince Andrew), Princess Eugenie (father: Prince Andrew), Prince Andrew (father: Prince Philip), Princess Anne (father: Prince Philip), Prince Edward (father: Prince Philip), etc. Also include grandchildren: Prince George (father: Prince William), Princess Charlotte (father: Prince William), Prince Louis (father: Prince William), Archie (father: Prince Harry), Lilibet (father: Prince Harry), etc.

We need to decide scope: "current British Royal Family" could be all who have the style "His/Her Royal Highness". That includes: King Charles III, Queen Camilla, Prince William & Kate, Prince Harry & Meghan, Prince George, Princess Charlotte, Prince Louis, Princess Anne, Prince Edward, Sophie, Countess of Wessex (now Duchess of Edinburgh), Prince Richard, etc. Possibly also the more distant like Princess Beatrice, Eugenie, their families. Provide a table.

We'll provide concise answer. No need for external lookup; we know. Ensure accuracy: Prince Charles's father: Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh. Camilla's father: Major Bruce Shand. William's father: King Charles III. Kate's father: Michael Middleton. Harry's father: King Charles III. Meghan's father: Thomas Markle. George's father: Prince William. Charlotte's father: Prince William. Louis's father: Prince William. Anne's father: Prince Philip. Andrew's father: Prince Philip. Edward's father: Prince Philip. Sophie’s father: Christopher Lascelles? Wait: Sophie, Countess of Wessex (now Duchess of Edinburgh), father: Major Ronald Lascelles? Actually Sophie’s father is Christopher Lascelles? Let's recall: Sophie Rhys-Jones's father is Christopher "Chris" Lascelles? Let me check: Sophie, Countess of Wellesley (no). Actually Sophie, Countess of Wessex's father is Christopher Lascelles? I think Sophie's father is Christopher Lascelles? Wait, Sophie’s maiden name is Sophie Rhys-Jones. Her father is Christopher "Chris" Lascelles? No, that's wrong. Let's recall: Sophie Rhys-Jones was born to Christopher and Mary Rhys-Jones. Her father was Christopher Rhys-Jones, a former company director. So father: Christopher Rhys-Jones.

Prince Edward's father: Prince Philip. Sophie’s father: Christopher Rhys-Jones. Also include Princess Beatrice's father: Prince Andrew. Princess Eugenie's father: Prince Andrew. Also include their mothers but not needed.

Also include Princess Anne's father: Prince Philip. Also include Princess Anne's children: Peter Phillips (father: Mark Phillips? Actually father is Mark Phillips? Wait: Peter Phillips is child of Princess Anne and her first husband Mark Phillips. So father: Mark Phillips). Similarly Zara Tindall (father: Mark Phillips). But they are not HRH; they are not royals but part of family. But they are members.

The user likely expects a list: e.g., King Charles III - father Prince Philip; Queen Camilla - father Bruce Shand; Prince William - father King Charles III; etc.

Will produce a table of main members: King Charles III, Queen Camilla, Prince William, Catherine, Prince Harry, Meghan, Prince George, Princess Charlotte, Prince Louis, Princess Anne, Prince Edward, Sophie, Prince Andrew, Princess Beatrice, Princess Eugenie, Peter Phillips, Zara Tindall. Provide fathers.

Will note that some fathers are deceased. Provide that.

Let's answer.

content:
Below is a concise “who‑is‑who” table for the people who are most commonly regarded as the **current members of the British Royal Family** (i.e., those who carry the style *His/Her Royal Highness* or who are immediate descendants of the monarch).  
For each person the table lists the **father** (with a note if the father is deceased).

| Royal family member (as of 2025) | Relationship to the monarch | Father (and status) |
|----------------------------------|-----------------------------|---------------------|
| **King Charles III** | Monarch (son of Queen Elizabeth II) | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (deceased, 2021) |
| **Queen Camilla** (Consort) | Wife of the monarch | **Major Bruce Shand** (deceased, 2006) |
| **Prince William, Prince of Wales** | Heir‑apparent (son of Charles III) | **King Charles III** (alive) |
| **Catherine, Princess of Wales** | Wife of Prince William | **Michael Middleton** (alive) |
| **Prince George of Cambridge** | Eldest child of William & Catherine (2nd in line) | **Prince William, Prince of Wales** (alive) |
| **Princess Charlotte of Cambridge** | 2nd child of William & Catherine (3rd in line) | **Prince William, Prince of Wales** (alive) |
| **Prince Louis of Cambridge** | 3rd child of William & Catherine (4th in line) | **Prince William, Prince of Wales** (alive) |
| **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** | Younger son of Charles III | **King Charles III** (alive) |
| **Meghan, Duchess of Sussex** | Wife of Prince Harry | **Thomas Markle Sr.** (deceased, 2023) |
| **Archie Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Son of Harry & Meghan (5th in line) | **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** (alive) |
| **Lilibet “Lili” Mountbatten‑Windsor** | Daughter of Harry & Meghan (6th in line) | **Prince Harry, Duke of Sussex** (alive) |
| **Princess Anne, The Princess Royal** | Daughter of Queen Elizabeth II (sister of Charles III) | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (deceased, 2021) |
| **Peter Phillips** | Son of Princess Anne (grandson of Elizabeth II) | **Mark Phillips** (alive) |
| **Zara Tindall (née Phillips)** | Daughter of Princess Anne (granddaughter of Elizabeth II) | **Mark Phillips** (alive) |
| **Prince Edward, Earl of Wessex (now Duke of Edinburgh)** | Son of Queen Elizabeth II (younger brother of Charles III) | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (deceased, 2021) |
| **Sophie, Countess of Wessex (now Duchess of Edinburgh)** | Wife of Prince Edward | **Christopher Rhys‑Jones** (deceased, 2000) |
| **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** | Son of Queen Elizabeth II (second son of Elizabeth II) | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (deceased, 2021) |
| **Princess Beatrice, Mrs Edoardo Mapelli Mozzi** | Daughter of Prince Andrew | **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** (alive) |
| **Princess Eugenie, Mrs Jack Brooksbank** | Daughter of Prince Andrew | **Prince Andrew, Duke of York** (alive) |
| **Princess Alexandra, The Hon. Lady Ogilvy** | First cousin of Queen Elizabeth II (daughter of Prince George, Duke of Kent) | **Prince George, Duke of Kent** (deceased, 1942) |
| **Prince Michael of Kent** | First cousin of Queen Elizabeth II (son of Prince George, Duke of Kent) | **Prince George, Duke of Kent** (deceased, 1942) |
| **Princess Margaret, Countess of Snowdon (deceased 2002)** – *included for completeness* | Younger sister of Queen Elizabeth II | **Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh** (deceased, 2021) |

### How the table is organized
* **Royal family member** – the person who is currently (or very recently) a recognizable member of the British Royal Family.  
* **Relationship to the monarch** – clarifies how they sit in the family tree.  
* **Father (and status)** – the name of the father and whether he is still living (most senior fathers are now deceased).

### Quick reference of the senior line

| Person | Father |
|--------|--------|
| King Charles III | Prince Philip (deceased) |
| Prince William | King Charles III |
| Prince Harry | King Charles III |
| Princess Anne | Prince Philip (deceased) |
| Prince Andrew | Prince Philip (deceased) |
| Prince Edward | Prince Philip (deceased) |
| Princess Beatrice & Princess Eugenie | Prince Andrew |
| Prince George (grandson of Elizabeth II) | Prince Edward |
| Princess Alexandra & Prince Michael (Kent line) | Prince George, Duke of Kent (deceased) |

> **Note:** The Royal Family is a living, evolving institution. The list above reflects the most widely‑recognised members as of late 2025 and their paternal lineage. If you need a deeper dive into more distant relatives (e.g., the extended House of Windsor) or a focus on a particular branch, just let me know!
